parameters.initialAndTerminalPolicy: Observed identity at t=0; remap ticks 300..35700; no terminal t=600 remap.
parameters.permutation: Fisher-Yates on lexically sorted active IDs for lexically sorted source body handles; uint32LE SHA256([nullSeed,sourceSeed,replicate,block,index,attempt]) with rejection sampling; fixed points allowed.
parameters.lifecycleRepair: Remove dead bodies and expired labels, retain all valid bindings, lexically zip vacant bodies and free active labels; repair before shuffle if coincident.
parameters.storage: Exact per-event body-to-label mapping ledger and virtual archive hash; physical archives never copied to output.
parameters.topologyAverages: All 12001 analysis samples including t=0; weighted degree pooled over active node-time, isolates included.
parameters.rank: Within-seed midrank 100*(below+equal/2)/available replicates; descriptive only, no acceptance threshold.
parameters.durationPolicy: Existing observer semantics; completed intervals only for duration summaries, right censoring separately.
